instruction: Set an image as the background for the fifth slide in the opened presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting an image as the background on slide 5 (index 4). The evaluator checks if a NEW background image was added to slide 5 by comparing the initial state with the final state. The custom getter extracts the PPTX file, parses the slide XML structure, retrieves the background image data, and returns comprehensive information including image ID and raw image bytes. The metric function compares the initial and final states to verify that either (1) no background existed initially and one was added, or (2) the background image changed (different image data/ID), ensuring a new background was actually set.
metadata.verification: Verified slide 5 (index 4) exists in the 20-slide presentation. The evaluator compares initial and final states to ensure a NEW background image was added (not pre-existing). The getter retrieves both metadata (image ID) and actual image data (bytes) to enable robust comparison and prevent false positives from pre-existing backgrounds. The simplified instruction focuses on what can be reliably verified: adding a background image to slide 5.
